items.title: The invertible modules on a ringed space are represented up to isomorphism by a set
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a set of invertible modules meeting every isomorphism class exactly once (author lemma at source lines 4531-4537, label lemma-pic-set). The proof (source lines 4539-4558) uses that an invertible module is locally a direct summand of a finite free module, parametrises the local pieces by direct summands of finite free modules over a covering, and observes that the isomorphism classes of those pieces, the glueing data and the coverings each form sets (proof lines 4540-4557). The parametrisation together with the set-theoretic bookkeeping is the content. H2.
